name: Kari Zev
description: Kari Zev is a human sky pirate from Avishkar, captain of the skyship Dragon's Smile, who works with the Renegades on Kaladesh.

description_citations.text: "Kari Zev". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Kari Zev is a human sky pirate from Avishkar, captain of the skyship Dragon's Smile, who works with the Renegades on Kaladesh.

bio.text: She ran away from Ghirapur at thirteen after being expelled from her apprenticeship, and she met the stowaway monkey Ragavan aboard the Sun Chaser.

citations.text: "Kari Zev", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kari Zev", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At fifteen she was a notorious pirate captain who fought for pay as well as the cause, and she and Jace used his illusions to steal aether canisters from a Consulate ship.

citations.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.
"The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.
"The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

bio.text: The Skysovereign had destroyed her fleet of fourteen ships, and she helped bring it down, using aether as bait for a skywhale that rammed it.

citations.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.
"The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

bio.text: She also rescued Baral from Phyrexian attackers and forced him to join her crew.

citations.text: "Kari Zev", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In Aetherdrift she sponsored the Keelhaulers and commentated on the race, and a statue honors her on the course.

timeline.summary: Godwyn is captured by Phyrexians, compleated, and leads a conquest of New Argive until Kari betrays and kills him.
timeline.quote: until he is betrayed and killed by his second-in-command, the Compleated woman Kari .

citation.text: "The Myths of Magic", section "Phyrexian Creations by J. Robert King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Godwyn devastates Argivian cities until his second-in-command Kari slays him.
timeline.quote: until he was ultimately slain by his second-in-command, Kari

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kari and Jace use Jace's illusions to pose as a Consulate vessel and steal canisters of aether from a Consulate collecting ship.
timeline.quote: smuggling canisters of their inventory onto her ship under the approving gaze of Consulate stooges

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari bluffs a suspicious Consulate lieutenant who doubts her age, with Ragavan's screech helping.
timeline.quote: Perhaps there's a reason you're still a lieutenant. Think on that.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari tells Jace she fights for pay as well as the cause; Jace says he is here only for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I don't fight for freedom, and I certainly don't fight for free.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: At First Launch, Ukti reveals that Pia's group lost the Aether Hub and leads Kari and Jace to her secret sanctum.
timeline.quote: "Pia's group lost the Aether Hub. They're all scattered now.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari introduces Jace to the Derby Crows, who were at the Hub with Pia.
timeline.quote: They were called the Derby Crows.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The Crows show the Skysovereign blockading the city and say the Heart of Kiran cannot get past it.
timeline.quote: "There's no way Heart of Kiran 's getting through that monster,"

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari reveals the Skysovereign destroyed her fleet of fourteen ships near Lathnu, leaving only the Dragon's Smile.
timeline.quote: When it was done with my fleet, Dragon's Smile was the only ship to make it out.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace says he has an idea after learning Kari knew her destroyed fleet well.
timeline.quote: "Then we have no time to waste. I have an idea."

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari addresses her raiders, five Derby Crows and seven crew, to cause enough trouble to attract the flagship.
timeline.quote: Cause enough of a stink for their flagship to take notice.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Depala dives the Dragon's Smile into the Consulate blockade, scattering the formation, and the raiders deploy.
timeline.quote: Dragon's Smile soared between the first of the Consulate ships and through the gap in the blockade.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari fights Consulate enforcers on the deck and in flight.
timeline.quote: Kari and the dwarf tumbled to the deck of Dragon's Smile .

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures an illusory fleet from Kari's memories of her destroyed ships, which fills the sky.
timeline.quote: Her fleet had returned to her, and they were assembling to fill the space above a plaza

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The officer fires a net; Ragavan takes it for Kari and is carried off, and Kari chases the officer.
timeline.quote: In the next heartbeat, the officer was off—and with her, the net containing Kari's prince.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari wrecks the officer's propeller with her sword and rescues Ragavan.
timeline.quote: Kari just winked at the officer, and shoved her sword into the spinning action of one of the four propellers

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari meets skywhales in an aether eddy and decides to use the aether as bait.
timeline.quote: But then she stopped. And all at once, she saw it. Opportunity.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari smashes jettisoned aether canisters, a skywhale rams the Skysovereign, and the flagship drifts to the ground.
timeline.quote: the whole thing listed to one side and drifted slowly to the ground.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari Zev rescues Baral and forces him to join her, with Ragavan watching him.
timeline.quote: Kari Zev assigned her trusted First Mate Ragavan to keep a close watch on Baral

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kari Zev tells Vin that Spitfire knows where to find her if she wants to prove herself.
timeline.quote: She knows where to find me if she really wants to prove herself

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Kari betrays and kills Godwyn.
timeline.quote: he was betrayed and killed by the Compleated woman Kari

citation.text: "Argivia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kari runs away from Ghirapur at thirteen after being expelled from her apprenticeship.
timeline.quote: Kari packed up her things and ran away from home at age thirteen

citation.text: "Kari Zev", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kari meets the stowaway monkey Ragavan aboard the Sun Chaser.
timeline.quote: where she met the monkey Ragavan

citation.text: "Kari Zev", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kari saves Baral from Phyrexian attackers and offers him a place in her crew or the void.
timeline.quote: he was unexpectedly saved by Kari Zev

citation.text: "Kari Zev", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kari sponsors the Keelhaulers at the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: she sponsored the Keelhaulers

citation.text: "Kari Zev", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: your illusion won us all this

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.
